scope: Raw lexical extraction only; no readings, confidence, or alternatives assigned.

location_conventions.lines: 1-based; LF, CRLF, and bare CR each start one new line; every raw newline character remains unchanged.
location_conventions.columns: 1-based Unicode code-point counts from the start of each line.
location_conventions.character_offsets: 0-based Unicode code-point offsets; all span ends are exclusive.
location_conventions.utf8_byte_offsets: 0-based offsets into the original UTF-8 bytes; all span ends are exclusive.
location_conventions.raw_argument: Exact source slice between structural braces; an unclosed argument retains its available slice through EOF.
location_conventions.scan: Integer derived solely from a scanNNN.tex filename suffix; null when the filename has no such suffix.
